text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During training...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hello. I hope you don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! B-Bourbon?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: She's going to be your training partner.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: She's going to be your training partner.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Just for today, we are teammates. If you'll
have me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice, the training I'm accustomed to is,
according to others,
"demonic".

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But seeing as you've defeated me before,
you should be able to keep
up. Let's make
today worth it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hwehh!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, not "hweh." Now then, let us begin.
First up, four uphill dashes.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice takes off running as if being hounded
by Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I'd better get to it myself. The
Tenno Sho is nearly upon us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I simply cannot wait to run alongside Rice.
Aren't you excited too,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: McQueen looks at me with a wry smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take that to mean I'd better convince
Rice to compete.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I trust that you will.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, say what? Rice is gonna be in the
Tenno Sho too?! Oh boy, I
gotta get the
word out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, what are you—? Wait just a minute!
This isn't supposed to be
public yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our special training session gets off to a
lively start.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As I expected, you've kept up with my
"demonic" training. And now
for the final
exercise.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Rice, I want you to race me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Race you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You bested me in the Kikuka Sho. It
shouldn't be an unreasonable
task.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But, but I...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Having seen such a powerful performance
from you, I find your
timidness rather
unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In the Kikuka Sho, you had me in your
sights from the start, and never
let me
escape for even a second.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You worked hard to beat me, and your
running showed it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And now, I am working hard in order to
beat you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However... In your current state, I won't
actually need to work hard at
all to win.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I don't want that. The Rice I know isn't
someone I could best without
putting in
the work.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Bourbon...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: So run, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Just like you did in that race, show me that
you want to win.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Want... to win...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I love running... but I just can't seem to
win. And when I see McQueen
race—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... I want to win too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. That's the whole reason why
I switched teams, why I
trained so hard...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even if some people don't like it when I
win, I... I want...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want to win!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see you've finally found your drive again.
Well then, let's finish our
training.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh? Rice and Bourbon are going at it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Rice is keeping her eyes forward now.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: She remembered why she wants to win—who she wants to win against.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: She remembered why she wants to win—who she wants to win against.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm gonna go be their ref!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(She's so fast! Faster than in the Kikuka
Sho...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (She trained hard... because she wanted to win against me.)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(The crowd refused to recognize me, but
she did.)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (And I can't let her down!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see that same ambition she exuded in the
Kikuka Sho. The drive to
win pushes her
forward.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: There it is! Rice Shower wins!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Rice, you ran well. Even better than you
did in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon... I did it... I remembered what it
was like to want to win
against you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And I was able to see your running
firsthand again. It seems I have
much more
training to do.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Our next meeting will be in the Twinkle
Series... as unparalleled
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I, um... I'll run in the Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to win. Even if it's an important race
for McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Heh. I wouldn't have it any other way.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice has decided to rise to the challenge
once more. The Tenno Sho
awaits.
